exposure: women not admitted for bed rest
cohort: 117 women with threatened miscarriage and 117 matched asymptomatic controls
finding: Threatened miscarriage is associated with a higher risk of spontaneous abortion, placenta previa, PROM, PPH, preterm birth, and cesarean section, while bed rest was found to improve fetal survival.
mod_finding: Women with threatened miscarriage were more likely to undergo cesarean section.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was slightly lower in infants of mothers with threatened miscarriage (3.113 ± 0.585kg) compared to controls (3.285 ± 0.536kg), but the difference was not statistically significant.
